usage.callShape: POST https://stablegiftcards.dev/api/invoice with JSON body {"invoice_id":"<id>"} and a SIWX wallet signature (no x402 payment)
usage.outputShape: On success: body with invoice status + redemption codes (Bitrefill /invoices/{id} shape). On unknown id: body.success=false, body.error="Bitrefill /invoices/{id}: 404 ... Invoice not found". On bad input: body.success=false, body.error="Validation failed", body.issues[]
quirks: This is NOT the paid purchase endpoint the registry summary implies. The server's own description is 'Check invoice status and retrieve redemption codes' — it is a read-only status/code-retrieval lookup for an invoice you ALREADY bought.
Auth is SIWX, NOT x402. It returns the SIWX challenge (HTTP 402-style body with extensions['sign-in-with-x']) until you sign; once signed it is FREE — no USDC charged. Use --siwx.
Required body field is snake_case invoice_id (string). {invoiceId:...} or empty body returns 400 'Validation failed'.
Unknown/invalid invoice_id returns HTTP 500 wrapping the upstream Bitrefill 404 ('Invoice not found', error_code not_found). A 500 here means bad id, not a dead endpoint.

You need a real invoice_id minted by the SEPARATE purchase endpoint first — this endpoint cannot be exercised standalone to a 200. A 200 success could not be produced during QA (no real invoice on hand).
Sibling /api/search also now requires SIWX (changed since the 2026-06-01 probe that reported plain 402/free).
usage.guide: POST to https://stablegiftcards.dev/api/invoice with a SIWX wallet signature (no payment is charged — it is free with --siwx). Send JSON body {"invoice_id":"<the id returned by the purchase endpoint>"}. Read the invoice status and redemption codes from the success body (Bitrefill /invoices/{id} shape). If you pass an unknown id you get HTTP 500 wrapping Bitrefill's 'Invoice not found'; if you omit invoice_id or use camelCase you get HTTP 400 'Validation failed'. This endpoint only LOOKS UP existing invoices — the actual gift-card purchase happens on a separate endpoint.
